title: Playing with George, bass player Jose and the steamer to Covington
summary: Occasional jobs with George, Jose the bass player, and the boat to Mandeville and a country club job in Covington.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Um, then I, you see, did you play with George? You played with George then when you made those records, but had you been playing with George much before that?

Yes. I had played jobs with George, you know. I didn't play study because I was busy with those other bands, you know. But I played lots of jobs with George when I couldn't play. Well, he'd get, there's a fellow by the name he called, Jose. You might have heard talking, Jose, a bass player. Well, he was playing.

Funnily enough, I heard of, you know who told me and mentioned his name? It was Emma George's wife. Emma, she, I was saying, who were the people that played over there, over the Lakers? Yeah. He said there was a man called Jose.
That's right. I'd never heard that name before.
No. Well, I mean, he was annoying, you know what I mean? He played all right. He was...
Did he play over the Lakers?
Yes, he went over the Lakers with them, yeah.

And, uh, Buddy Van, before, I tell you, when they made us go over the Lakers, we was waking on them, on the steamer camellia. It used to run from, uh, Lellenboyd to Manville. We used to play on that boat, you know, it's a passenger boat going over to bring people like that. And we worked over there, and, uh, one of the guys from over in Covenant wanted, uh, to book the band. So, well, Buddy accepted that, taking it over to you. We didn't make much money, but I mean, we had so much fun, and, you know.
Now, can you remember exactly where it was that you played, where he did, where he was
in Covenant? The first place? No. No, I couldn't exactly say the first place, but I knew it was, uh, a club. I think that was the country club, they call it, out there. It was a nice, nice big place.
